result:
I found and fixed 12 rules in `pricebook.py` that didn't match their docstrings, including the shared rules at the top of the file. I re-ran the check afterward and all 150 rules now match.

**How I checked:** I wrote a reference version of every rule from its docstring and compared it to the real function for quantities 0–259 at 11 unit prices (0 to 99,999). Before the fixes, those same 12 rules failed. I also read the file by eye and found the same 12. The check script is in the scratchpad, not the project.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 07, 141, 142 | The cap was applied to the price (`min(base, cap) * pct`) | Work out the discount first, then cap the discount |
| 133 (marginal) | The cap was applied to the amount above the threshold, not the discount | Cap the discount instead |
| 16, 105 | Discount started at `qty >= 101`, docstring says 100+ | Changed to `>= 100` |
| 37 | Discount started at `qty >= 6`, docstring says 5+ | Changed to `>= 5` |
| 19, 92 | Used `round()`, which rounds to the nearest won instead of rounding down | Changed to `// 100` (always rounds down) |
| 111, 124 | Marked marginal, but the discount was on all units | Discount only the units above the threshold, e.g. `(qty - 20) * unit` |
| 125 | Used 6%, docstring says 5% | Changed to `5 // 100` |

STATUS: DONE
